name: password
useCase: Identify a password field or an action to manage passwords.
misuse: Do not use this symbol as a strength or security rating; label the available password action.

16.reason: The narrower asterisk sits inward from the input border, with a separate short entry mark and at least 1px of painted clearance.

24.reason: A larger asterisk and longer entry mark keep at least 1.5px of space from the input border and remain visibly separate.
